sloka: क्षुद्र कर्मा हि कैकेयी द्वेषात् अन्याय्यम् आचरेत् ।परिदद्या हि धर्मज्ञे भरते मम मातरम् ॥२-५३-१८॥
transliteration: kṣudra karmā hi kaikeyī dveṣāt anyāyyam ācaret ।paridadyā hi dharmajñe bharate mama mātaram ॥2-53-18॥

translations.english: Kaikeyi who is a woman of heinous deeds may follow, out of hostility, an unjust way in respect of my mother. In that case my mother may be entrusted to the care of Bharata who is righteous.
